falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score above 70 indicates a confirmed blowoff top, directly contradicting the current HOLD signal and UNKNOWN phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Price closes above the 200-day moving average by more than 3%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout above this key trendline would invalidate the HOLD signal by confirming a strong bullish trend, not a consolidation phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Relative Strength Index (RSI) diverges with price making higher highs while RSI makes lower lows
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This bearish divergence would indicate weakening momentum, invalidating the UNKNOWN phase by confirming a potential reversal against the HOLD signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
